title: cwa-association-2003-world
label: Dizz

won.source: Its own title history, captured November 2003, lists Dizz from June 21; the page prints no year and the capture dates it to 2003. The brief history says the CWA crowned a World champion in Dizz that night.

how: The first World champion on the title history.

won.source: Its own title history, captured November 2003, lists The Moose from August 4 (no year printed).

label: Dizz

how: A second reign.

how: The owner's own character.

title: cwa-association-2003-world
label: Dizz

how: A third reign.

title: cwa-association-2003-world
label: Q

won.source: Its own title history, captured January 2004, lists the holder under a tag-style name from December 1; the same page's July entry and the brief history give Q for that holder.

note: Its own page lists the holder under a tag-style name; the identification with Q rests on the July 2003 entry, which the brief history gives to Q.

won.source: Its own title history, captured January 2004, lists Dante from December 22 (no year printed).

title: cwa-association-2003-world
label: Vigilante

won.source: Its own title history, captured February 2004, lists Vigilante from January 19; its March 2004 front page names The Vigilante World champion.

note: The 29 March 2004 Terror in the Aisles card has Max Cameron pin him for the title.

won.source: Its own title history, captured November 2003, lists Mach as Inter-Continental champion from June 21 (no year printed).

title: cwa-association-2003-superior
label: Q

won.source: Its own title history lists the holder under a tag-style name from July 5; the brief history says Dizz lost by count out to Q, so Q is given the belt Mach vacated.

note: The Hardcore title merged with the Inter-Continental on July 5 to form the Superior title, according to its title history.

won.source: Its own title history lists Shannon Skanes from September 15 (no year printed).

title: cwa-association-2003-superior
label: Vigilante

won.source: Its own title history, captured November 2003 and February 2004, lists Vigilante from November 3; its March 2004 front page names The Vigilante Superior champion.

note: The 23 February 2004 Assault has The Moose pin him for the belt when he falls on his back.

title: cwa-association-2003-hardcore
label: Romeo Salvador

won.source: Its own brief history: Romeo Salvador wins Hardcore Hell on May 10 and becomes the hardcore champion; its title history lists May 10 to May 25.

how: Won Hardcore Hell, the first hardcore champion on record.

title: cwa-association-2003-hardcore
label: Leech

won.source: Its own brief history: Leech takes the hardcore title in a glass chamber match with Romeo Salvador, Mick Foley as special guest referee (as the page bills it), May 25.

how: Won a glass chamber match at Overload.

title: cwa-association-2003-hardcore
label: The Moose

won.source: Its own brief history: The Moose won a double cage match for the hardcore title on June 29 at Sunstroke.

how: Won a double cage match.

won.source: Its own title history, captured November 2003, lists a revived hardcore title with Max Cameron from October 20 (no year printed).
Its own title history lists Dante from October 27 (no year printed).

title: cwa-association-2003-hardcore
label: Max Cameron

won.source: Its own title history, captured February 2004, lists Max Cameron from November 3 to January 19 (no year printed).

how: A second reign.

title: cwa-association-2003-hardcore
label: Leech

won.source: Its own title history, captured February 2004, lists Leech from January 19 to the present; its March 2004 front page names Leech Hardcore champion.

how: A second reign.
note: The 22 March 2004 Assault has Shannon Skanes win the belt from him in a three-way.

title: cwa-association-2003-hardcore
label: Shannon Skanes

won.source: Assault, 22 March 2004: Shannon Skanes wins the three-way with Leech and Max Cameron for the Hardcore title.

how: Won a three-way with Leech and Max Cameron.
note: Terror in the Aisles, 29 March 2004, calls him the new CWA Hardcore champion; no later held card shows a change of the belt.

Its own brief history: Celia wins the Cruiserweight title from Damien on June 21.

label: Wren SilverPhoenix

won.source: Its own title history lists Wren SilverPhoenix from August 16 to September 5, then Dissolved; its news post congratulates Wren on becoming the new Aerial champion.

note: The belt was listed as dissolved after this reign.

label: Pyro

won.source: Its own title history, captured February 2004, lists Pyro from December 22 to January 3 (no year printed).

how: The first Women's champion on the title history.

label: Scarlet Bitch

won.source: Its own title history lists Scarlet Bitch from August 24.

how: A second listing.

title: cwa-association-2003-superior
label: The Moose

won.source: The 23 February 2004 Assault: Vigilante falls on his back and The Moose pins him for the Superior title.

how: Pinned Vigilante, who took a dive.
note: Lost the belt to SinmaN at Outrage on 26 April 2004.

title: cwa-association-2003-superior
label: SinmaN

won.source: Outrage, 26 April 2004: SinmaN hooks the tights after a DDT and takes the Superior title from The Moose.

how: Pinned The Moose after Viper dragged the referee out.
note: Lost the belt in a three-way with Vesuvius and Tommy Air at Blind Rage on 24 May 2004.

title: cwa-association-2003-superior
label: Tommy Air

won.source: Blind Rage, 24 May 2004: Tommy Air wins the three-way for the Superior title.

how: Won a three-way with SinmaN and Vesuvius.
note: No later held card shows a change of the belt.

title: cwa-association-2003-world
label: Max Cameron

won.source: Terror in the Aisles, 29 March 2004: Wren chairs Vigilante and Max Cameron pins him to become World champion.

how: Pinned Vigilante after Wren's chair shot.
note: Beat Q on the 12 April 2004 Assault to keep the belt; lost it to Leech at Outrage on 26 April 2004.

title: cwa-association-2003-world
label: Leech

won.source: Outrage, 26 April 2004: Leech pins Max Cameron and wins the World title.

how: Pinned Max Cameron.
note: He puts the title up for The Moose and Dizz the next week; how his reign ends is not on a held card, and Ash wins the title in a three-way without him at Blind Rage on 24 May 2004.

title: cwa-association-2003-world
label: Ash

won.source: Blind Rage, 24 May 2004: Ash wins the three-way with Frank Merritt and Lone Star and the World title.

how: Won a three-way; the holder he took it from is not on a held card.
note: Retains the title over Chastity on the 7 June 2004 Assault, the last held card on which the belt is mentioned.

title: cwa-association-2003-world-tag
label: Dark Forces

won.source: The 22 March 2004 Assault: Dark Forces take the World Tag titles from the Dark Ice Symphony.

how: Won the titles from the Dark Ice Symphony.
note: Retain the belts at Outrage on 26 April 2004 and Blind Rage on 24 May 2004; no change is on a held card.
